user.title: Choose a soundbar
user.description:
Before adding this soundbar, you must pair and trust it at the OS level (e.g. using `bluetoothctl` in the terminal: `pair <MAC>` followed by `trust <MAC>`), then reboot your Home Assistant host. Also make sure the VIZIO mobile app is closed and your phone is disconnected.

{error}

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect or authenticate. Ensure the soundbar was paired and trusted in bluetoothctl, the host machine was rebooted, and no other device/phone is connected.

data.disconnect_when_idle: Disconnect when idle (lets the VIZIO mobile app connect)

data_description.disconnect_when_idle: Off (default): Home Assistant stays connected, so volume changes from the remote show up instantly, but the soundbar can't be used by the VIZIO mobile app at the same time. On: the link is dropped after 2 minutes without activity.
data_description.max_volume: Device-level volume guard rail (default: 100). The Home Assistant volume slider scales from 0 to this limit (e.g. setting 40 means 100% on the slider maps to volume level 40).
